description: Original SWF layers recomposed for calm desktop motion; blink timing and gaze are adaptations, not official animation timelines.
exporter: JPEXS 26.3.0; original SWF XML, neutral/palette-probe PNG, fixed registration
adaptations: junior source down frame 3; middle source down frame 1
original body, eye white, pupil and middle leaf placements retained separately
half-blink compresses original eyes vertically to 22%; closed eyes reuse original happy shape 665 at original eye centres
single uniform scale per form; same registration for every layer; runtime colour masks preserve eye whites and leaves
no independent ground shadow; original body shading retained
